blocks.text: `break` ends the loop at once. `continue` skips the rest of this round and goes on to the next. `pass` does nothing: Greengold does not allow an empty body, so you write it where you leave one empty on purpose.
Above, 3 was skipped and the loop ended at 7.

blocks.prompt: Among the numbers from 1 to 20, find the first one divisible by 7, print it, then leave the loop.

options: Skips the rest of this round and goes to the next
blocks.why: It is `break` that ends the loop.
